---
title: "Summary"
open-graph:
  site-name: "**Bold** {{< meta title >}} name"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[property="og:site_name"][content="Bold Summary name"]']
---

An explicit `open-graph.site-name` containing Markdown and a shortcode must reach `og:site_name` as rendered plain text.
